input.prompt: Vertical architectural photograph inside a dark exposed-concrete hall. A tall seamless portrait-orientation LED screen stands on the floor against the far wall and fills about sixty percent of the frame height, perfectly flat and front-facing, centred, displaying one plain uniform soft white-grey glow and nothing else. The screen is the only light source; its light falls on the polished dark concrete floor as a long soft reflection and fades into deep shadow at the edges. Camera at eye level, 35mm lens, symmetrical, calm. Shot on a Sony A7R V, true-to-life colour, realistic exposure, fine natural grain, restrained cinematic grade with soft highlights and warm shadows. Quiet luxury, architectural photography. No people. No readable text anywhere, no logos, no watermark.
